privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file contains 8 Cytochrome c sequences: P99999, P67881, P00048, P00053, P00044, P04657, P00004, and P62895. Cytochrome c is a highly basic protein; expected pI values are typically in the range of 9.0 to 10.5. The recommendation file must identify the specific accessions with the maximum and minimum pI from this set and suggest a pH range (e.g., 3-11 or 7-11) that encompasses all calculated pI values.
